subject: Minute-scale bridge: short-term capacity & PO coordination
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@zoomly.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai; procurement@zoomly.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short notice: 15M token min burst for pilot tomorrow

Hi Chloe —

We have a pilot spike tomorrow tied to a product demo and need a short‑window uplift to cover ~15M extra tokens over a 6‑hour window (minute-scale peaks). Current commit won't cover it. Procurement asked me to ask whether Redwood can (a) temporarily increase quota, (b) provide an overrun true‑up rate and (c) confirm whether we can get a separate PO for a short capacity add‑on.

Can you share commercial options (pricing per‑token for overrun, any minimums, and quick PO flow) so we can approve today? We may also want a small one‑time discount if we commit to a larger quarterly addendum after the pilot.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, Zoomly

From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@zoomly.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: 15M token min burst for pilot tomorrow

Samir —

Thanks for the heads up. Short summary of options we can stand up within hours: 

1) Emergency minute‑scale uplift (paygo overrun): we can lift quota for the window and charge a premium over base rate. Proposal: $0.016/token for the overrun block (one‑time bill), billed with next invoice. No minimum; needs PO.
2) Temporary prepaid top‑up: you prepay a one‑time slab to cover 15M tokens at a negotiated slab rate $0.013/token. Unused tokens roll into Paygo at base rate for 30 days. Requires PO and takes ~24 hours to clear if finance approves.
3) Pilot addendum (recommended if you expect repeated spikes): 3‑month provisional uplift with an introductory 10% discount on overrun pricing if you convert to a quarterly commit within 30 days.

To move fast, the quickest path is option (1) + a same‑day PO emailed to billing. If you want the slab (2), procurement needs to sign the attached PO draft and we can route DocuSign.

Attached: draft capacity terms and a PO template.

I'll loop Ben and Laura for discount/approval and PO handling.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai; Samir Patel <samir@zoomly.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: 15M token min burst for pilot tomorrow

Samir / Chloe —

I can greenlight a modest one‑time concession on the overrun rate for the pilot: if Zoomly signs the pilot addendum within 7 days we'll do $0.014/token for the one‑time slab (option 2) up to 15M. Otherwise option 1 stands at $0.016/token. This concession is conditional on a mutually executable PO and a short billing hold‑harmless clause (standard).

If they want to convert to a quarterly commit after the pilot, we can ladder to a 12% discount on committed slabs.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Enterprise Accounts

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@zoomly.com>
Cc: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: 15M token min burst for pilot tomorrow

Hi Samir —

Finance checklist to execute either path quickly: 
- Clean PO referencing Redwood Invoice T&C (use PO template attached).
- If you choose the one‑time slab (option 2) and want the $0.014/token concession, we need the signed PO + confirmation to route to DocuSign. Processing typically completes in 8–24 hours once PO is received.
- For option 1 (emergency lift) we can approve within the hour once Chloe confirms the window; billing will invoice at $0.016/token with standard net30.

I'll attach the billing remedy note to the invoice if you choose option 1 so your procurement team can reconcile the short‑term uplift.

Attachments: PO template (attached for signature).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Renewals & Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@zoomly.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: 15M token min burst for pilot tomorrow

Thanks all —

We will take the emergency lift (option 1) for tomorrow's window to avoid any demo risk. Procurement will email a PO tonight referencing the premium overrun charge and we will aim to sign the slab addendum for the pilot if the numbers look good post‑demo. Please proceed with the quota lift 08:00–14:00 PDT tomorrow (16 Mar).

Samir
